```{r}
# MaAsLin2 RefSeq genus-level association models
# Purpose: test RefSeq fungal and viral genera against outcome and sPTB34,
# with unadjusted models.

# -----------------------------
# Local file paths
# -----------------------------

data_dir <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Data"

metadata_path <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_path <- file.path(data_dir, "refseq_fungal_family_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv")
viral_path  <- file.path(data_dir, "refseq_viral_family_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv")

out_root <- file.path(data_dir, "maaslin2_refseq_family_results")
dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# Load matrix and match metadata
# -----------------------------

load_and_match <- function(matrix_path, metadata_path) {
  
  # Load abundance matrix: rows = samples, columns = taxa
  mat <- read.delim(
    matrix_path,
    header = TRUE,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  # Remove trailing "_1" from sample IDs if present
  matrix_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(mat))
  rownames(mat) <- matrix_ids_clean
  
  # Load metadata
  meta <- read.delim(
    metadata_path,
    header = TRUE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  # First metadata column contains ID_1, ID_2, etc.
  colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"
  
  # Check all matrix samples exist in metadata
  unmatched <- setdiff(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)
  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    stop("Unmatched samples found: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # Match metadata order to matrix order using reads_ID only
  meta <- meta[match(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID), ]
  
  # Confirm order is correct
  if (!all(meta$reads_ID == matrix_ids_clean)) {
    stop("Metadata order mismatch")
  }
  
  rownames(meta) <- meta$reads_ID
  
  return(list(mat = mat, meta = meta))
}

# -----------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# -----------------------------

prepare_metadata <- function(meta) {
  
  # Main outcome: TERM reference, sPTB comparison group
  meta$outcome <- factor(meta$outcome, levels = c("TERM", "sPTB"))
  
  # Secondary outcome: no reference, yes comparison group
  meta$sPTB34 <- factor(meta$sPTB34, levels = c("no", "yes"))
  
  # BMI adjustment variable
  meta$bmi <- as.numeric(meta$bmi)  
  return(meta)
}

# -----------------------------
# Run one MaAsLin2 model
# -----------------------------

run_maaslin_model <- function(mat, meta, dataset_name, outcome_var, adjust_bmi = FALSE) {
  
  fixed_effects <- outcome_var
  
  if (adjust_bmi) {
    fixed_effects <- c(outcome_var, "bmi")
  }
  
  keep <- complete.cases(meta[, fixed_effects, drop = FALSE])
  
  # MaAsLin2 input data: rows = samples, columns = taxa
  mat_model <- as.data.frame(mat[keep, , drop = FALSE])
  
  # MaAsLin2 metadata: rows = samples, columns = variables only
  meta_model <- as.data.frame(meta[keep, fixed_effects, drop = FALSE])
  
  # Force clean sample IDs
  sample_ids <- rownames(mat)[keep]
  rownames(mat_model) <- sample_ids
  rownames(meta_model) <- sample_ids
  
  # Safety checks
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(rownames(mat_model))))
  stopifnot(!any(rownames(mat_model) == ""))
  stopifnot(!any(duplicated(rownames(mat_model))))
  stopifnot(all(rownames(mat_model) == rownames(meta_model)))
  
  model_name <- paste0(
    dataset_name, "_",
    outcome_var, "_",
    ifelse(adjust_bmi, "BMI_adjusted", "unadjusted")
  )
  
  out_dir <- file.path(out_root, model_name)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  message("Running: ", model_name)
  message("Samples: ", nrow(mat_model))
  message("Taxa: ", ncol(mat_model))
  message("Sample IDs match: ", all(rownames(mat_model) == rownames(meta_model)))
  
  Maaslin2(
    input_data = mat_model,
    input_metadata = meta_model,
    output = out_dir,
    fixed_effects = fixed_effects,
    normalization = "TSS",
    transform = "LOG",
    analysis_method = "LM",
    correction = "BH",
    max_significance = 0.05,
    standardize = FALSE,
    plot_heatmap = TRUE,
    plot_scatter = TRUE
  )
  
  message("Finished: ", model_name)
}

# -----------------------------
# Load and prepare datasets
# -----------------------------

fungi <- load_and_match(fungal_path, metadata_path)
viruses <- load_and_match(viral_path, metadata_path)

fungi$meta <- prepare_metadata(fungi$meta)
viruses$meta <- prepare_metadata(viruses$meta)

# -----------------------------
# RefSeq fungi family
# -----------------------------

run_maaslin_model(fungi$mat, fungi$meta, "refseq_fungal_family", "outcome", FALSE)
run_maaslin_model(fungi$mat, fungi$meta, "refseq_fungal_family", "sPTB34", FALSE)

run_maaslin_model(fungi$mat, fungi$meta, "refseq_fungal_family", "outcome", TRUE)
run_maaslin_model(fungi$mat, fungi$meta, "refseq_fungal_family", "sPTB34", TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# RefSeq viruses family
# -----------------------------

run_maaslin_model(viruses$mat, viruses$meta, "refseq_viral_family", "outcome", FALSE)
run_maaslin_model(viruses$mat, viruses$meta, "refseq_viral_family", "sPTB34", FALSE)

run_maaslin_model(viruses$mat, viruses$meta, "refseq_viral_family", "outcome", TRUE)
run_maaslin_model(viruses$mat, viruses$meta, "refseq_viral_family", "sPTB34", TRUE)

message("Completed.")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

results_dir <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Data/maaslin2_refseq_results"

# Read all MaAsLin2 all_results.tsv files
maaslin_files <- list.files(
  results_dir,
  pattern = "all_results.tsv",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

all_maaslin <- lapply(maaslin_files, function(file) {
  
  model_name <- basename(dirname(file))
  
  read_tsv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(model = model_name)
  
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Add interpretation columns
maaslin_summary <- all_maaslin %>%
  mutate(
    result_type = case_when(
      qval < 0.05 ~ "FDR significant",
      pval < 0.05 ~ "Nominal p < 0.05 only",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ),
    direction = case_when(
      coef > 0 ~ "Higher in comparison group",
      coef < 0 ~ "Lower in comparison group",
      TRUE ~ "No direction"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    model,
    feature,
    metadata,
    value,
    coef,
    stderr,
    pval,
    qval,
    result_type,
    direction
  ) %>%
  arrange(qval, pval)

# View all FDR-significant and nominal results
signals_table <- maaslin_summary %>%
  filter(qval < 0.05 | pval < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(result_type, qval, pval)

View(signals_table)

# Save table
write_csv(
  signals_table,
  file.path(results_dir, "maaslin2_all_signals_summary.csv")
)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Plot BMI-adjusted MaAsLin2 candidate taxon overview
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
})

results_dir <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Data/maaslin2_refseq_results"

out_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

maaslin_files <- list.files(
  results_dir,
  pattern = "all_results.tsv",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

maaslin_files <- maaslin_files[grepl("BMI_adjusted", maaslin_files)]

df <- lapply(maaslin_files, function(file) {
  model_name <- basename(dirname(file))
  
  read_tsv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(model = model_name)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

plot_df <- df %>%
  filter(metadata != "bmi") %>%
  filter(pval < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    domain = case_when(
      str_detect(model, "fungal") ~ "Fungal",
      str_detect(model, "viral") ~ "Viral",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    
    comparison_label = case_when(
      metadata == "outcome" ~ "TERM vs sPTB",
      metadata == "sPTB34" ~ "sPTB34 yes vs no",
      TRUE ~ metadata
    ),
    
    comparison_group = case_when(
      value == "sPTB" ~ "sPTB",
      value == "yes" ~ "sPTB <34",
      TRUE ~ value
    ),
    
    effect = coef,
    
    neg_log10_p = -log10(pval),
    taxon_label = feature
  ) %>%
  arrange(domain, comparison_label, pval) %>%
  group_by(domain, comparison_label) %>%
  mutate(taxon_label = factor(taxon_label, levels = rev(unique(taxon_label)))) %>%
  ungroup()

if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
  stop("No BMI-adjusted MaAsLin2 nominal signals with p < 0.05 to plot.")
}

p <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = effect,
    y = taxon_label,
    size = neg_log10_p,
    colour = comparison_group
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(domain ~ comparison_label, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "sPTB" = "#9467bd",
      "sPTB <34" = "#ff7f0e"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "BMI-adjusted MaAsLin2 nominal taxon-level signals",
    x = "MaAsLin2 coefficient after BMI adjustment",
    y = NULL,
    size = "-log10(p-value)",
    colour = "Comparison group"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "BMI_adjusted_maaslin2_candidate_taxon_overview_refseq_only_coloured.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 11,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "BMI_adjusted_maaslin2_candidate_taxon_overview_refseq_only_coloured.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 11,
  height = 9
)

message("Figure saved to: ", out_dir)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

results_dir <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Data/maaslin2_refseq_family_results"

maaslin_files <- list.files(
  results_dir,
  pattern = "all_results.tsv",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

fdr_significant_results <- lapply(maaslin_files, function(file) {
  
  model_name <- basename(dirname(file))
  
  read_tsv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(model = model_name)
  
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  filter(qval < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      coef > 0 ~ "Higher in comparison group",
      coef < 0 ~ "Lower in comparison group",
      TRUE ~ "No direction"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    model,
    feature,
    metadata,
    value,
    coef,
    stderr,
    pval,
    qval,
    direction
  ) %>%
  arrange(qval, pval)

write_tsv(
  fdr_significant_results,
  file.path(results_dir, "maaslin2_FDR_significant_results.tsv")
)

View(fdr_significant_results)

message("Saved FDR-significant results to: ",
        file.path(results_dir, "maaslin2_FDR_significant_results.tsv"))
```
